field_text_formatted.value: And to everyone else who kept it moving. rpayanm, dunebaud and Paulino Michelazzo cut releases. Bryan Sharpe, Peter Wolanin, Jeremy Stoller, Chandansha Fakir, Youri van Koppen and solideogloria got rc1 out. dshields, xamount, Sakshi Sharma and Francesco Maria Battaglia fixed the last things standing between rc2 and today. Jeffrey Clark, Aidan Lister and Magnus Gunnarsson were doing this back in the Drupal 6 days. If you have ever put a patch on this module, your name is in the changelog.
